components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The red action for trying the bundled Sample, opening a file, or continuing into an Inspection.
components.html: <button class='ds-button-primary' type='button'>Try the sample <svg viewBox='0 0 24 20' aria-hidden='true'><path d='m13 4 6 6-6 6M5 10h14' /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 18px; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--oxide-dark); border-radius: 2px; padding: 13px 24px; background: var(--oxide); color: #fffaf0; font: 620 0.84rem/1 'Manrope Variable', 'Manrope', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--oxide-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A transparent ruled action for file ingress and supporting choices.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 2px; padding: 13px 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 620 0.84rem/1 'Manrope Variable', 'Manrope', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary span { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.68em; font-weight: 450; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--paper-quiet); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: A square light/dark mode control with inline SVG icon treatment.
components.html: <button class='ds-theme-toggle' type='button' aria-label='Switch theme'><svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'><circle cx='12' cy='12' r='3.5'></circle><path d='M12 2.25v2.1M12 19.65v2.1M2.25 12h2.1M19.65 12h2.1M5.1 5.1l1.48 1.48M17.42 17.42l1.48 1.48M18.9 5.1l-1.48 1.48M6.58 17.42 5.1 18.9'></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 2px; padding: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-theme-toggle svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: square; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { background: var(--paper-quiet); color: var(--ink); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Offset Input
components.description: The mono offset field in the Byte Map; hexadecimal is the default notation.
components.css: .ds-offset-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--oxide-dark); font: 450 0.67rem/1.35 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-offset-input { width: 118px; min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--paper-quiet); color: var(--ink); font: 450 0.72rem/1.35 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-offset-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Structure Row
components.description: A source-order semantic row that owns a byte span and synchronizes the Inspector Selection.
components.css: .ds-structure-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 57px 1fr; gap: 4px 10px; min-height: 54px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-structure-row span, .ds-structure-row small { color: var(--ink-soft); font: 450 0.62rem/1.35 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-structure-row strong { grid-column: 2; font: 620 0.92rem/1.2 'Manrope Variable', 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-structure-row small { grid-column: 2; } .ds-structure-row-selected { background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-structure-row:hover { background: var(--paper-quiet); } .ds-structure-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Selected Byte Cell
components.description: A measured byte cell carrying the current exact Selection.
components.css: .ds-byte-cell { min-width: 38px; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 13px 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 450 0.78rem/1.2 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-byte-cell-selected { background: var(--oxide); color: #fffaf0; outline: 2px solid var(--oxide); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-byte-cell:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-byte-cell:focus-visible { position: relative; z-index: 1; outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Info Workspace
components.description: The educational counterpart to the Map workspace; its lesson follows the current Selection.
components.html:
The file's ID card

A fixed signature identifies the format before a decoder reads the rest of the file.

How to read it

Read these bytes as the format's identity.

Where it sits

The signature starts at offset 0.
components.css: .ds-info-panel { display: grid; gap: 56px; min-height: 520px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: clamp(70px, 8vw, 130px); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-info-panel h2 { max-width: 11ch; margin: 0; font: 540 clamp(3.4rem, 6vw, 6rem)/0.92 'Manrope Variable', 'Manrope', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-info-panel p { max-width: 58ch; margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 450 1rem/1.7 'Manrope Variable', 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-info-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; padding-top: 28px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); } .ds-info-grid h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font: 620 0.86rem/1.2 'Manrope Variable', 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-info-grid p { font-size: 0.8rem; }

narrative.overview:
HexLens is a full-screen editorial exchange between a promise and its proof. The landing route gives an oversized manifesto headline the left side of the page and a live byte/Structure proof the right side. Warm paper, near-black ink, restrained red, and hard rules make the binary file feel like a readable artifact rather than a terminal wall. Manrope carries the argument; JetBrains Mono measures offsets, bytes, and compact labels.

The Inspector keeps a Structure rail beside a large Map workspace, with Info as the educational counterpart. A selected Structure or byte is one semantic thread: it updates the raw span, Field interpretation, and the lesson that explains why the span exists. The mobile Inspector turns that workspace into four tabs—Structures, Bytes, Fields, and Info—while preserving the same Selection.
keyCharacteristics: Asymmetrical editorial landing with a live PNG proof and substantive ruled sections.
Warm paper light mode paired with a near-black warm dark mode.
Red is the action and Selection signal; mint is reserved for local/ready status.
Square controls, hard rules, flat surfaces, and almost no ornament or shadow.
Manrope for display/body; JetBrains Mono for technical data and labels.
One Selection synchronizes Structure, bytes, Fields, and an educational Info lesson.

rules.name: The One Red Signal Rule
rules.body: Red means action or the current semantic Selection. Do not spend it on decoration.

rules.name: The Mint Local Rule
rules.body: Mint means local, ready, or healthy status. It never means “selected.”

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Manrope explains the file; JetBrains Mono measures it.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Do not add small eyebrow or kicker labels above headings. Let the headline and rule carry the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: If a boundary, tone, or rule can establish hierarchy, do not add a shadow.

dos: Do lead with the editorial split: oversized promise on the left, live byte/Structure proof on the right.
Do use hard rules, warm paper tones, square controls, and restrained spacing to make hierarchy legible.
Do reserve red for action and Selection, and mint for local/ready status.
Do keep one Selection synchronized across Structure, bytes, Fields, Source preview context, and Info.
Do preserve the two-pane desktop Inspector and four-tab mobile Inspector model.
Do use Manrope for explanation and JetBrains Mono for measured data.
Do keep compressed PNG/WAV Payload bytes opaque and label previews as original-file rendering.
Do honor keyboard focus, roving tab behavior, and prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't reintroduce the replaced cool-blue console, editorial serif, rounded shell, floating card, gradient, or shadow-heavy system.
Don't add small eyebrow/kicker labels above headings, decorative pills/chips, or gratuitous ornament.
Don't use mint to imply Selection or red to imply privacy/local ownership.
Don't type arrow glyphs; use the authored inline SVG arrow treatment.
Don't turn the landing or Inspector into a terminal wall, metric dashboard, or unrelated tile collection.
Don't decode opaque Payload content or describe browser rendering as parsed output.
Don't collapse the byte grid until offsets and exact spans become ambiguous; preserve internal scroll on narrow screens.
